tools.name: search_compute_contracts
tools.description: Search every compute derivative contract the Compute Market Tracker records (futures and options on GPU rental and compute price indices) by venue, status, index publisher, jurisdiction, settlement or name. Returns each contract with its status, the index it settles against, its DAP Standard classif

tools.name: get_compute_record
tools.description: One record in full by id: a contract (ct-), an index series (ser-), a market participant (ent-) or an event (ev-). Includes its DAP Standard classification, its status history, which fields are still held back, and every source with its link.

tools.name: compute_market_events
tools.description: Announcements, exchange filings and regulator actions on compute derivatives, newest first, including dates still to come such as the end of a regulator review. Filter by date range, event type or contract.

tools.name: compute_list_prices
tools.description: The on-demand list price each cloud provider publishes to rent a GPU instance, read from the provider's own price feed (AWS Price List, us-east-1, one price list a month back to October 2020; Azure Retail Prices, eastus, with the date each price took effect). One line per provider and instance, neve

tools.name: list_compute_coverage
tools.description: What the current snapshot covers: its date, how many contracts, venues, indices and events it holds, every source and when it was last checked, and the method. Use before concluding that a contract or event does not exist.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "compute_list_prices" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: gpu, provider, instance, since, until, history
